correctness.rationale: At the start of stage i the unseen count is R=U_{i−1}+1. A single specified label escapes the q draws with probability a_i=(1−1/i)^q, while two specified labels both escape with probability (1−2/i)^q. This gives the conditional mean, the exact mean sum, and the centered regression/covariance by telescoping the a_i. Centered innovations are martingale differences bounded by q; their conditional variance is R p_i(1−p_i)+R(R−1)b_i, with p_i=q/i+O(i⁻²) and b_i=−q/i²+O(i⁻³) for fixed q. Orthogonality gives Var(U_i)≤q²i, hence R/i→1/(q+1) in L² and conditional variance →q²/(q+1)² in L¹ by boundedness. The normalized weighted sum of brackets converges in L¹ to q²/((q+1)²(2q+1)), using the Riemann sum of (i/n)^(2q) and the bounded weighted Cesàro error; the normalized bounded increments give conditional Lindeberg. The same second-moment calculation gives the sharp variance and time-correlation limit. Bounded differences applies to qn independent draws since replacing one changes the number of distinct labels by at most one. For q=2 let S=Σ_{j=0}^{n−1}j² and J=Σ_{m=0}^{n−2}m²Σ_{j=0}^m j². The joint absence formula gives Var=S/n²−S²/n⁴+2J/[n²(n−1)²]. Clearing by 180n⁴(n−1)² in comparison with the claimed factorization gives polynomials of degree at most eight. Independent exact-integer arithmetic gave equality at all nine points n=2 through 10, proving the polynomial identity with this degree bound. The asymptotics fix q (a horizon-dependent q in the finite formulas must still be common to all stages of that horizon). Uploaded checker inspected, not executed.

evidence: The 2001 author abstract explicitly gives a normal limit for the binary output count. The 2011 paper's indexed author abstract extends that output CLT to arbitrary fixed f≥2, and an indexed passage of the author's paper specifies the uniform recursive circuit with a fixed number of input nodes. The 2002 binary circuit paper's abstract gives a joint CLT for fan-out classes including zero. The fixed-pool coupon paper concerns a different collection model.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A fixed number of input nodes can be allowed by changing finitely many initial stages and relabeling. Choosing distinct uniform parents instead of with replacement requires resampling only when a stage tuple repeats a parent, probability O_q(1/i). With independent stage couplings the number of changed draws has L² norm O_q(log n), and each draw changes the output count by at most one. Thus neither convention defeats coverage for the centered Gaussian limit or its leading variance scale. Exact finite identities require the precise convention.

evidence: The growing graph is independent sampling from the newly released coupons. The standard circuit construction chooses parent labels uniformly with replacement among existing nodes; primary model passage read at OA extraction offsets 5100–7783. In a one-input q-ary circuit let gate i+1 choose the q stage-i draw labels as its parents.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: After adding gate n+1, an output is a label not yet used as a parent. Among labels 1 through n this is exactly the set of unvisited labels in the walk; gate n+1 itself is one additional output. Thus the circuit output count on n+1 labels equals U_n+1 pathwise. The walk's self-transition allowance is not a self-edge in the circuit: the parent is drawn one vertex index before the new gate.

originality.rationale: The exact mean is already a constant-duration specialization of Kijima–Shimizu–Shiraga. More decisively, the headline Gaussian limit is for the output count of a standard uniform random recursive circuit in different coordinates, already the subject of binary and f-ary output CLTs. The vertex shift below proves exact equivalence for uniform with-replacement parents, and even uniform distinct parents with fixed seed size change the centered count by o(√n) in L². Prior full-text access was incomplete, so this does not claim the exact variance constant or q=2 finite factorization was printed in those papers. The failure is based on the prior Gaussian coverage and the mathematical equivalence, not on unavailable papers.
residual_risks: The full binary and f-ary output papers could establish additional exact regression or variance overlap; their inaccessible contents are not used as proof of such coverage. Exact normalization as printed in the old papers was not verified. No historical priority or provenance judgment is made.

value.rationale: The principal contribution is an already studied output-count CLT restated as walk coverage. Exact regression follows from the affine single-label escape identity, and the q=2 factorization is useful for checking a finite calculation but does not by itself establish an independently useful new regime or invariant beyond the equivalent model's elementary two-label calculation. The assessment does not deny the utility of fluctuation analysis in genuinely different growing network models.
